title.id: Undang-Undang yang membebaskan kapal kecil dari ketentuan Undang-Undang Nomor Tujuh Ratus Delapan Puluh berjudul 'Undang-Undang tentang Pemeriksaan dan Pemberian Lisensi kepada Pelamar Jabatan Nakhoda, Mualim, Pemilik Kapal, dan Insinyur Kapal Laut dalam Perdagangan Pantai Filipina serta Menetapkan Jumlah Insinyur yang Harus Dipekerjakan oleh Kapal-Kapal Tersebut'
title.ms: Akta yang membebaskan kapal-kapal kecil daripada keperluan Akta Nombor Tujuh Ratus Lapan Puluh yang bertajuk Akta yang Menyediakan Pemeriksaan dan Lesen bagi Permohonan Jawatan Kapten Kapal, Pegawai Nautika, Majikan Kapal dan Jurutera Kapal Laut dalam Perdagangan Pantai Filipina dan Menetapkan Bilangan Jurutera yang Perlu Diupah oleh Kapal-kapal Berkenaan

text.en:
So much of Act Numbered Seven hundred and eighty, entitled "An Act providing for the
examination and licensing of applicants for the positions of master, mate, patron, and engineer of seagoing
vessels in the Philippine coastwise trade, and prescribing the number of engineers to be employed by such
vessels," as provides that steam vessels of less than one hundred tons burden, or sailing vessels of less than
one hundred and fifty tons burden, shall carry licensed officers, is hereby repealed: Provided, however, That
all vessels propelled wholly or in part by steam shall carry and employ a licensed engineer or engineers, as
provided in said Act Numbered Seven hundred and eighty.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 26, 1904.
